seoTitle: VAT Return Summary Builder From Pasted Lines
metaDescription: Total output and input VAT by rate from pasted sales and purchase lines and see the VAT payable or reclaimable.
intro: Groups pasted invoices by rate into output VAT, input VAT and the net amount.
why:
Before filing, many people need a quick check of how much VAT they collected and paid. Paste one line per invoice and the totals are grouped by rate.

It is a summary for your own bookkeeping. Return boxes, special schemes, reverse charge entries and non-deductible VAT differ by country.
howTo: Write S or P, date, description, net amount, rate.
Read VAT collected, paid and the balance.

faq.a: No. It only totals your lines.
The tool divides by one plus the rate to get the net.
Nothing you type leaves your browser.
